scenario.name: complete_athlete
scenario.description: Fully populated baseline — no missing data.
scenario.stresses_principle: Baseline (control case, not a hostile scenario)

scenario.name: missing_load_data
scenario.description: Activities with no HR and no power — must resolve to Unknown, never 0.

scenario.name: delayed_sync
scenario.description: One activity's synced_at is 5 days after start_time.
scenario.stresses_principle: ADR-008 checkpointed sync / Feature 7.2 cache invalidation

scenario.name: cross_provider_duplicates
scenario.description: Every ride appears once via Peloton and once via Strava, with ~3min clock skew.

scenario.name: zero_training_week
scenario.description: Days 7-13 have zero activity records (true rest, not Unknown).
scenario.stresses_principle: ADR-019: Zero, Missing, and Unknown are distinct states

scenario.name: rapid_weight_change
scenario.description: A sudden, large weight drop in the back half of the window.
scenario.stresses_principle: Milestone C §3: weight is a trend, never an inferred performance driver

scenario.name: back_to_back_hard_sessions
scenario.description: 14 consecutive high-intensity days, no easy days at all.
scenario.stresses_principle: Feature 8.3/8.4/8.6: high Monotony + elevated Ramp Rate signal

scenario.name: deload_week
scenario.description: Weeks 1-3 normal load, week 4 deliberately light (a real deload, not missing data).
scenario.stresses_principle: TSB should trend positive/fresh, not be flagged as a data-quality issue

scenario.name: incomplete_records
scenario.description: Secondary fields (distance, calories) missing while HR/power are present.
scenario.stresses_principle: Normalization: confidence reflects only load-relevant completeness

scenario.name: peloton_no_hr
scenario.description: Peloton cycling classes with power but no paired HR monitor.
scenario.stresses_principle: Milestone A §4: TSS should compute (power+FTP present) despite no HR

scenario.name: strava_no_power
scenario.description: Strava runs with HR but no power meter (running, so expected).
scenario.stresses_principle: ADR-015: TRIMP fallback when power/FTP unavailable
